title: An Agent-Oriented Pluggable Experience-RAG Skill for Experience-Driven Retrieval Strategy Orchestration
why_relevant: Proposes a retrieval strategy orchestration skill that routes among retrievers based on task type, which is tangentially related to adaptive retrieval/control.
why_not_or_caveat: Does not address robustness, noise, conflict, adversaries, calibration, or uncertainty; purely about retrieval strategy selection for performance.
